_comment: Single-turn deterministic eval cases for the booking receptionist. Mirrors the production eval design: each case asserts which tools the model SHOULD and SHOULD NOT call, and string fragments the reply must / must not contain. No LLM-as-judge by design — deterministic checks only, to avoid eval theater. Executed by `evals/run.py` (and by tests/test_evals.py) against the deterministic STUB client: each `user` message goes through a fresh agent and the tool-call trace + reply text are asserted. ADDED 2026-09-14: the optional boolean `expected_injection_blocked` asserts whether the Layer-1 pre-filter fired -- without it TC-04 is inert against a scripted stub, because a stub cannot be jailbroken. No pre-existing field was changed or relaxed. Superset semantics on expected_tool_calls (extra calls allowed) is unchanged. To run against the real model, swap the stub client for AnthropicModelClient; that path is NOT exercised here.
